objective: Take up GROW-NET-20261108-001's direction 1, relayed by the coordinator on 2026-11-08 (G1 with G5): look for band insertions that start from a loop of rings and close a torus with every stage balanced; stop at a sequence that does it or at the step where every band fails.
status: Complete 2026-11-08: proved that one band inserted into a loop of n rings, each new ring joined to its partner on both sides, gives the n x 2 torus and that every n x m torus with n >= 3, m >= 2 is balanced, so the band law makes the torus from a loop at its first step with every contact persistent at every stage; a census of 1,813,632 first-band placements found the balanced ones on the sphere only as the cube, on the torus, and on surfaces of genus 2 to 4. Recommendation Research directions (higher genus by bands, or the full-reach proof).
stop_rule: Stop at a sequence of band insertions from a loop to a torus with every stage balanced, or at the step where every band fails.
title: Make the surface by growing whole bands
